title: Multi-angle Flow
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-560 - The Flow track. Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-560/plan.md. Joined 2026-10-18 (Fabio, board tidy).

One image of a locale becomes 4, 6 or 8 shots of the same place from different angles via an image edit model, for scene consistency (video-model references, places to put characters). The work is finding the prompt. MPI-623 is the exact-camera-placement sibling.
